summary: SOPHiA GENETICS SA filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) on June 16, 2026, for an underwritten public offering of ordinary shares (nominal value CHF 0.05) listed on Nasdaq (ticker: SOPH). The offering is a follow-on equity raise under an existing shelf registration. The last sale price on June 15, 2026, was $5.01 per share. Specific terms (number of shares, price, underwriter discounts) are left blank as this is a preliminary filing. TD Cowen is the lead book-running manager. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
